extracted.summary: A partner at Pemberton Solicitors has asked for a call about funding options for an unnamed client, without giving any details of the matter.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance, and for thinking of us for your client's matter. So that we can direct your enquiry to the right person, it would help to know the type of matter (for example a divorce or financial remedy case, or an estate being administered), the jurisdiction, and the stage proceedings have reached. We would also need the amount of funding your client is considering, the value of the assets in dispute or the estate, and any upcoming hearing or tax deadline dates. Once we have those details we will come back to you to discuss next steps.
